name: Odin, Ruler of Asgard
effect:
1 "Nordic Ascendant" Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
Must first be Synchro Summoned.
This card is always treated as an "Aesir" monster.
You do not pay LP to activate "Solemn" Trap Cards.
If this card is Special Summoned: You can Set 1 "Solemn" Trap from your Deck or GY.
(Quick Effect): When your opponent activates a card or effect: You can send 1 card from your hand to the GY; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card.
If this card leaves the field: You can Special Summon 1 "Aesir" monster from your GY or Extra Deck, except "Odin, Ruler of Asgard". You can only use each effect of "Odin, Ruler of Asgard" once per turn.
